info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Sequoia Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Sequoia Jacket Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed product specifications for the Sequoia Jacket within the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to define essential attributes, features, and specifications necessary for the jacket's listing. Typical consumers include product managers and e-commerce platforms looking to enhance their inventory with detailed product information. By utilizing this API, developers can ensure accurate and rich representation of product details, improving customer engagement and satisfaction.

post.summary: Create new details for a Sequoia jacket.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new specifications and details for a Sequoia jacket. It captures all relevant attributes to ensure that the product meets customer expectations and standards.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the details for the Sequoia jacket. It contains all necessary information required to create or update the jacket's details in the system.

200.description: The request was successful and the details are returned.

CreateCatalogSequoiaJacketDetailRequest.title: Sequoia Jacket Order Request

sequoia_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Sequoia jacket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person who requested the jacket.

quantity.description: The number of Sequoia jackets to be ordered.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the order is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The price for a single unit of the Sequoia jacket.
